newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt impounds Ukrainian ship for unpaid bills.
newsitem.headline: Egypt impounds Ukrainian ship for unpaid bills.

text.p: Egyptian authorities on Sunday impounded a Ukrainian cargo ship in the Red Sea port of Suez after its owners failed to pay $42,000 to local provision suppliers, shipping sources said.
The suppliers got a legal order to impound Matvey Muranov after they could not get their money from the ship owners, Azov Shipping Co., they added.
Matvey Muranov, with a gross-weight of 3,935 tonnes, was carrying general merchandise from Singapore to Odessa, on the Black Sea, when it was impounded.
Egypt has impounded several ships in recent months for unpaid dues and some of them fled from its territorial waters.
